metaDescription: Affinity, by Canva, is a free professional design app that combines vector design, photo editing and page layout in one app for Mac, Windows and iPad. See its features, pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: Affinity is a professional design app by Canva that brings vector design, photo editing and page layout together in one app and one file format. You can switch between vector, pixel and layout tools in the same document, without exporting or moving between apps.

Since Canva relaunched it in 2025, Affinity has been completely free for individuals: all vector, layout and pixel tools are available with a free Canva account. Optional Canva AI tools inside Affinity need a Canva premium plan. Affinity runs on Mac, Windows and iPad.

features.title: Vector design
features.text: Warp shapes, build forms and edit paths node by node, with expressive brushes.

features.title: Photo editing
features.text: Retouching, RAW development, compositing and creative edits.

features.title: Page layout
features.text: Desktop publishing with full control of type and layout, ready for print.

features.title: One app, one file
features.text: Vector, pixel and layout tools work together in a single .af file.

features.title: Affinity for iPad
features.text: The same professional tools, built for touch and Apple Pencil.

features.title: Canva AI tools
features.text: Optional AI features inside Affinity with a Canva premium plan.

strengths: All professional tools are free for individuals.
Vector, photo and layout in one app.
No subscription needed for the core app.
Runs natively on Mac, including Apple silicon, as well as Windows and iPad.
limitations: You need a free Canva account to use it.
Canva AI tools inside Affinity need a Canva premium plan.
Available on Mac, Windows and iPad only.

pricing.summary: Affinity is free for individuals with a free Canva account. Canva AI tools inside Affinity require a Canva premium plan.
